note: Every GPU the router can run on: services/router/config/fleet.json (FLEET_SOURCE=mock) or fleet.live.json, joined with the latest catalog offer for its price, speed and interruption risk. bookedWindows come from compute's /gpus/{computeGpuId}/calendar plus the router's own rental bookings. available is false with a reason: RECLAIMED, OFFLINE, NO_CAPACITY, STALE_PRICE (offer older than CATALOG_MAX_AGE) or OFFER_MISSING. endpoint is a boolean (the URL is never returned).
